summary: Tested the gender-based doctor placeholder fix (frontend-only, Expo web preview at localhost:3000, mobile viewport 375x667). FIX VERIFIED WORKING: (1) Consult list /consult — all 5 no-photo female doctors on page 1 (Neha Panchal id=12, Dr.Nivedita id=14, Khushi Rathod id=15, Dr. KAJOL GUPTA id=33, Deepika Kumari id=37) render the FEMALE illustrated placeholder; md5 of the served image matches local asset doctor-placeholder-female.png exactly. No-photo male doctors (Mohammad faizan id=24, Dr MOHIT id=32) render the MALE placeholder; md5 matches doctor-placeholder-male.png. (2) /doctor/12 hero shows the female placeholder in circular frame over dark green (md5-verified, screenshot 02); /doctor/32 hero shows the male placeholder (md5-verified, screenshot 04). (3) ZERO console errors, zero red screens. HOWEVER criterion 3 FAILS for a pre-existing reason: /doctor/11 (Dr AP Singh) real photo does NOT display — hero is blank dark green (screenshot 03). Root cause: Hostinger CDN (hcdn) serves a 403 JS bot-challenge page ('Checking your browser before accessing') for every https://api.onlinevaidyaji.com/uploads/profiles/* image; Chrome blocks it as net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB. Confirmed with curl (plain AND full browser headers both 403). This affects ALL 10 doctors with Hostinger-hosted avatars on the list (blank avatar circle) — NOT caused by the placeholder fix (pre-fix evidence screenshots_iter36/05 shows the same blank hero). Google-hosted avatars (lh3.googleusercontent.com) load fine.

integration_issues.flow: Doctor profile photo display (list avatar + detail hero)
integration_issues.issue: Hostinger hcdn bot protection 403s all cross-origin image loads from api.onlinevaidyaji.com/uploads/profiles/. Reproduced with curl: plain request AND browser-UA+Referer+Origin request both get HTTP 403 text/html challenge page. Cannot be fixed client-side with headers.

action_items: Placeholder fix itself: NO action needed — verified correct (gender === 'female' → female illustration, else male; md5-verified against bundled assets on both list and detail screens).

HIGH: Fix broken Hostinger-hosted avatars. Options: (a) Hostinger control panel — exclude /uploads/* (or static media) from hcdn bot-protection/JS challenge; (b) serve profile media through the FastAPI backend (server.py already mounts /uploads/profiles StaticFiles for app-uploaded photos — consider migrating/proxying website uploads the same way); note a naive server-side proxy to api.onlinevaidyaji.com will ALSO hit the JS challenge (plain curl 403), so Hostinger-side exclusion or relocating the media is required; (c) bundle/copy the real profile photos into the app's own uploads dir at seed time.

Consider an onError fallback on the list/hero Image so a failed real photo falls back to the gender placeholder instead of a blank circle/hero (currently broken remote images render as empty boxes with no indicator).
critical_code_review_comments: consult.tsx:333-344 and doctor/[id].tsx:213-226 — placeholder selection logic is correct: avatar_url (or doc.image on detail) takes precedence; otherwise gender==='female' ? female : male require() asset. require() of bundled PNGs works in Metro web (served at /assets/?unstable_path=... and md5-identical to the source files).

Neither Image has an onError handler — a failed avatar_url leaves a blank circle (list) or blank brand-dark hero (detail). Adding onError → setState fallback to the gender placeholder would make the UI resilient to the Hostinger 403 issue.
Detail hero uses `doc.avatar_url || doc.image` (doctor/[id].tsx:213) while the list only uses avatar_url — minor inconsistency, harmless.

consult.tsx directory cache (AsyncStorage, 5-min TTL) stores gender/avatar_url so placeholder selection works from cache — verified list rendered from network with correct placeholders; no stale-cache risk for this fix.

rca_of_issue: Bug under test (female placeholder shown as male/none): FIXED and verified — cause was list/detail only having a male placeholder path; fix bundles both illustrations locally and selects via API gender field. Newly documented issue (real photos blank): Hostinger's hcdn edge serves an interstitial JS browser-check page (HTTP 403, content-type text/html, 'Checking your browser before accessing') for every request to api.onlinevaidyaji.com/uploads/profiles/*. Chrome then blocks the response as net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB, so RN-web <Image> fires onError and renders nothing. Reproduced via curl with full browser headers — it is CDN/WAF config, not client code. Mitigation: exclude /uploads/* from bot protection in Hostinger panel, or relocate/proxy media through the FastAPI app's own host (server.py already mounts /uploads/profiles locally for app-side uploads).
